brief: The test pyramid is dead — 6 patterns that replace it for modern stacks.

slots.subText: Six modern patterns that ship faster with real confidence and fewer flaky suites.

slots.title: Contracts over mocks
slots.subtitle: Replace static mocks with verified consumer-provider agreements that catch breaking changes pre-deploy.
slots.b1Body: Teams agree on payloads before either side ships to production.
slots.b2Body: Breaking schema changes never reach staging or production environments.

slots.title: Integration beats isolation
slots.subtitle: The testing trophy proves most bugs live at the wiring layer, not in pure functions.
slots.b1Body: Hit databases and APIs in ephemeral test environments.
slots.b2Body: Fewer mocks means less maintenance and higher signal tests.

slots.title: Generate the edge cases
slots.subtitle: Property-based tests explore input space automatically, finding bugs your examples never cover.
slots.b1Body: Libraries simplify failing inputs to the minimal reproducer automatically.
slots.b2Body: Assert properties hold across thousands of generated random cases.

slots.title: Break it on purpose
slots.subtitle: Chaos experiments validate resilience before reality injects failures at 3 AM.
slots.b1Body: Start with small faults and expand as confidence steadily grows.
slots.b2Body: Abort experiments when deviations exceed defined metric thresholds.

slots.title: Pixels are behavior
slots.subtitle: Catch unintended UI drift across browsers before users do in production.
slots.b1Body: Compare renders across Chrome, Safari, and mobile viewports.
slots.b2Body: Review and approve intentional visual diffs through collaborative workflows.

slots.title: Test in production
slots.subtitle: Synthetic probes and feature flags shift validation from staging to real traffic.
slots.b1Body: Continuously exercise critical paths against production deployments.
slots.b2Body: Ship to one percent of traffic and observe metrics closely.

slots.ctaBody: Pick one pattern, run a pilot this sprint, and watch your flaky suite become a signal machine.
